newsitem.title: UK: Wolseley inches up after cautious statement.
newsitem.headline: Wolseley inches up after cautious statement.

text.p: Shares in Wolseley Plc were slightly firmer on Tuesday after the building materials group reported top-of-the range six-month figures.

The shares were up 2p to 498-1/2 by 0830 GMT. But the company also said the strength of sterling and weak Continental economies, particularly in France and Austria, would result in slower sales growth in the second half of the current financial year.
"For the group as a whole, continued weakness of sterling will have an adverse impact on second half results," the company said in a statement.

The building materials group reported first-half pre-tax profits of 124.3 million stg, at the top end of analysts' forecasts. The first-half dividend of 3.3 pence was in-line versus 3.10 pence a year ago, was in-line with expectations.
"The figures were generally pretty good but the trading statement was slightly bearish," one market maker said.
"I don't really look for the shares to do to much today. We've seen a few early buyers but nothing convincing."
